description: Takes its radius from rounded-sm and rounded-2xl in place of rounded-floor and rounded-card, which the tokens item removes. Every radius renders at the same size.

Spacing between a card's parts comes from the spacing tokens: facts in a row and the labelled facts' columns are gap-related (8px, from 12px and 16px), labelled facts stack with no gap (from 4px), and the empty picture's icon and word and CardExplain's icon and trigger text are gap-related (8px, from 4px).

Adds CardFooter: one muted line after the card's other parts; it throws on a link or a button, which go in CardAside. CardAside styles a link among its always-shown items. CardAction and CardExplain throw inside a hover card, which marks its content with CardHoverOnly. CardFacts takes layout "bullets", one bullet per fact with CardFact's new icon prop; install the bullet item with card.

Component introduced: Card, CardSubject, CardMedia, CardId, CardName, CardDescription, CardLink, CardAside, CardAction, CardFacts, CardFact, CardExplain and CardMissing, moved from the card experiment.
